long_biography.plain_text:
Feldman began selling cars at fifteen in his father's Michigan Chevrolet store. He studied business and automotive marketing at Northwood University and completed the NADA Dealer Academy. He joined the family dealerships full-time, became dealer operator of Jay Chevrolet and later formed his own holding company.

His expansion method combined buying underperforming stores with partnering managers and outside operators. The approach took the business across Michigan, Ohio and Indiana and into more than a dozen vehicle brands. In 2018 he added a separate Ohio partnership with Mark Wahlberg, extending the same operator-led model beyond the original dealership footprint.
